capabilities.title: Subsurface depth surface
capabilities.description: Validated polygon footprint rendered as a bounded matte plane at its validated depth in the anchored local-metric 3D frame, with an outlined map footprint. Optional validated dip is reported as schematic text only (strike unknown); optional validated uncertainty renders as a bounded wireframe band, clipped to the declared easting bound where one exists. Never interpolates or invents surface between control points.
capabilities.composition_failure: point-observation renders points, not areal extents; vertical-profile renders columns at point locations; path renders lines. None can express a bounded depth surface without inventing interpolation between control points, which the truthfulness contract forbids. Extension adds no document-specific branch: it keys on polygon geometry plus finite elevationMeters, validated dipDegrees/uncertaintyMeters, and capability id only.

capabilities.title: Reference plane
capabilities.description: Validated polygon footprint carrying referenceKind water-level, rendered as a distinct translucent plane at its validated depth plus a map footprint and a one-click clip preset (Clip at water level). Visually distinct from evidence horizons (lower opacity, cool sequential tone, no categorical assignment). Disabled with a reason when no reference layer validates.
capabilities.composition_failure: No composition of point-observation/path/vertical-profile can express a non-evidence datum plane with a clip preset: region fills have no 3D presence, and evidence columns cannot act as clip datums. Extension keys on layer referenceKind plus finite elevationMeters only.

capabilities.title: Transect section curtain
capabilities.description: Validated transect line extruded from the ground datum to its declared base depth as a schematic translucent curtain in the anchored 3D frame, with map highlight and shared selection. Explicitly labelled schematic wherever described; never claims surveyed continuity between boreholes.
capabilities.composition_failure: path renders the transect on the map only; vertical-profile renders columns at points. Neither produces a vertical section reading under the line. The curtain is bounded strictly by the declared line vertices and declared base depth (validated finite meters), adding no interpolated geology.
